Audit Issue (Point): www vs. non-www — full site duplication
Original State (Before): Redirect rules pointed from www to non-www and duplicate content was served on both domains.
Updated State (After): Added RewriteEngine rules in .htaccess and public/.htaccess to redirect non-www requests to secure www domain (https://www.mounteko.com), commented out old redirect rules, and added self-referencing canonical tags to head layout.
Primary Impact: Splitting SEO ranking signals and indexation bloat.
